messages:
lina: FYI noticing a rapid NVMe temp + i/o queue backlog in ap-southeast3, GPU pods stuck Pending due to attach timeouts
rafi: which pool/hosts? any kernel logs?
lina: pool=ephemeral-meta-2, hosts gnode-apse3-42..47. dmesg snippet: 
lin a: ```
[ 23456.100] nvme0n1: io_queued=512 io_inflight=48
[ 23456.101] nvme0n1: ctrl: aborting command status=0x12
[ 23456.102] nvme0n1: temperature threshold exceeded: 81C
```
zoe: 81C is high. smart shows reassigns increasing on 44 and 46
rafi: interesting — metrics show metadata-sync RPCs to kvstore spiked at same time (10k/s)
zoe: timeline: we rolled metadata compaction tuning (more aggressive flushes) at 02:30 UTC to reduce memory pressure
tom: hypothesis: compaction/flush change => lots of synchronous small writes => NVMe queueing -> thermal throttling -> attach failures
lin a: customer impact: attach failures increased from 3% -> 18% in ap-southeast3 for batch launches
infra-bot: Alert: nvme_temp_p95>80C on ephemeral-meta-2. Incident registered INC-3812. https://internal/INC-3812
rafi: quick mitigations: 1) revert compaction tuning 2) rate-limit kvstore flushes 3) cordon affected hosts from gpu service 4) tweak vm.dirty_ratio temporarily
zoe: revert compaction now? risk of memory pressure. prefer rate-limit kvstore outgoing writes and throttle compaction concurrency
lin a: starting cordon of gnode-42..47 from gpu service now; will keep pods but block new attaches
tom: also lower io_scheduler writeback_threshold on canary host to reduce small write bursts
rafi: run small reproducer on canary after drain: fio --name=meta-sim --rw=randwrite --bs=4k --iodepth=64 --size=4G --numjobs=2
zoe: vendor not involved yet — this looks endogenous to our compaction change
lin a: drain in progress, ETA ~7m
infra-bot: Incident INC-3812 updated: status=investigating responders=[lina, rafi, zoe, tom]
tom: applied kvstore rate-limit patch on master (limit 2k/s) and rolled to one canary host gnode-44
rafi: canary telemetry: nvme_temp p95 dropped 20C under similar synthetic load, queue depth reduced ~60%
zoe: attach failures dropped fleetwide in region from 18% -> 2.5% after cordon + rate-limit
lin a: follow-up actions: 1) revert compaction tuning in next 30m 2) keep kvstore rate-limit until next release 3) add dashboard panels (kv_flush_rate, nvme_qdepth, attach_fail_pct) 4) postmortem tomorrow 08:00 UTC
rafi: cost note: if we move capacity out of ap-southeast3 for extended period, estimate +$1.1k/day on spot/reserved mix
zoe: opening a short-lived alert to detect kvstore flush bursts crossing 5k/s
infra-bot: Incident INC-3812 status=mitigated responders=[lina, rafi, zoe, tom]
lin a: thanks team, leaving thread for postmortem notes :thumbsup:
